prompt: Implement the Bernstein-Vazirani circuit for the same hidden secret as the standard bv_5q task (s = 1011, from oracle f(x) = x0 XOR x1 XOR x3 on a 4-bit input), but using a REVERSED qubit-ordering convention: here the ANCILLA is qubit 0 (not qubit 4), and the input register is qubits 1-4 (not 0-3), with input qubit i of the standard task now at qubit (4-i). Concretely: original-qubit-0 is now qubit 4, original-qubit-1 is now qubit 3, original-qubit-3 is now qubit 1. Steps: initialize qubit 0 (ancilla) to |1> with an X gate, apply Hadamard to all 5 qubits, apply the oracle as CNOT(control=qubit 4, target=qubit 0), CNOT(control=qubit 3, target=qubit 0), and CNOT(control=qubit 1, target=qubit 0), then apply Hadamard to qubits 1-4 only (not the ancilla). Return the resulting 5-qubit state; no measurement.
